name: Field
purpose: One labelled text input or text area, with an optional hint and an error message.
whenToUse: Free text: names, email addresses, messages

whenNotToUse.case: Choosing from a short fixed list

states.how: data-invalid on root, aria-invalid on input, error shown and added to aria-describedby

props.name: label
props.does: The visible label, tied to the input

props.name: hint
props.does: Help text shown under the input and read with it

props.name: messages
props.does: The error text for each reason the value is not valid

keyboard.action: Moves in and out; leaving a field you typed in checks it

accessibility.web: Native label, input and textarea. The error is linked through aria-describedby and read when the input is focused, not announced as a live region, so it is heard once. On a failed submit, focus moves to the first field with an error.
accessibility.ios: SwiftUI TextField with accessibilityHint for the error
accessibility.android: Compose TextField with isError and supportingText

content: Errors say what to do: Enter an email address like name@example.com. No Error: prefix, no please.
